title: Close post-ship ordinary-path gaps found in Codex dogfooding
lane_outcome: Implement and prove all ten child issues #2722-#2731 through dependency-aware stacked PRs from current master, preserving independent closure boundaries and culminating in an ordinary supported-host replay.
purpose_for_parent: Restore ordinary resolve-act-reconcile trust across decision, authority, correction, proof, continuity, and improvement-signal owners without creating parallel frameworks.

technical_strategy: Deliver five dependency-ordered stack layers. Establish authority and correction custody first; make routing bounded and executable next; build one-step proof execution on those routes; restore external continuity using the resulting evidence contracts; then make captured dogfooding friction consequential and prove the combined ordinary path. Reuse existing owners and provider-agnostic boundaries throughout.
technology_choices: Existing Python runtime and JSON contracts remain authoritative.
GitHub-specific hierarchy and labels terminate at the external-intent adapter.
Existing review, correction-event, proof-receipt, Planning reconciliation, and improvement-signal stores are extended rather than duplicated.
